headline: Experimental design: five phases
tagline: Choose how to rank. Test on held-out topologies. Vary the amount of labelled data.
inputs_title: Two generators, the same benchmark problems
separate_cases: Analyze each generator separately, not as 208 independent networks.
split_title: Keep topology groups together across nested splits
split_note: Repeat the complete protocol for every outer split.
phase_subtitles: Translate known network quality into learning targets.
Remove less useful predictors using training data.
Refit selected procedures; predict before reading test quality labels.
Keep the AMIGA recipe and exact feature columns from phase 4.
label_output: Keep one label scheme per learner
label_fixed: Regression and classification use fixed targets.
grid_inner: Score each setting on 3 inner folds
grid_output: Keep parameters for each learner × task
grid_note: Same search policy for each supervised formulation.
feature_retained: Columns retained from the original table
feature_select: Inner validation chooses the retained fraction
feature_note: Relearn the selected column mask before outer evaluation.
selection_rule_title: Selection rule: minimize missed quality among the first 5 recommendations
selection_rule_detail: Regret@5 → Regret@1 → fewer columns in phase 3 → stable tie-break
frozen_title: Freeze the procedure for this outer split
frozen_detail: Model family · labels · parameters · feature budget
objective_panel: Separate panel: objective-only rules + exact random reference
oracle_note: The AUPR oracle is a nondeployable ceiling, not a competitor.
statistics: Regret@5 primary · Friedman + Holm, per generator
prediction_note: No seed selection or prediction ensemble; all five final seeds contribute.
recipe_lock: Fixed model family · labels · parameters · exact columns
learning_repetitions: 3 nested subset draws × 5 seeds · unchanged test folds
learning_scope: AMIGA only · no new model or column selection
learning_qualification: Conditional on the recipe chosen with the full training complement.
footer_lines: Regret: quality missed in the top k
scope_footer: Study 2 (TCGA-BRCA) and prediction costs are separate analyses, not extra phases here.
schematic_footer: Design schematic · icons and bars are illustrative, not experimental results.
